verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS payments and commerce platform that stores seller and customer data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose a storage region or set residency controls. The US-localized marketing URLs and the 'manage customer data securely' claim do not address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
